title: chytranthus macrophyllus var. obanensis

It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
